_note: The Lecture Hall is entirely series-driven ("items" is empty). Ten real YouTube imports back it (see series/<id>/series.json for each one's real channel/playlist id and episode list). "stanford-cs229" is deliberately referenced but has no programming.json block and zero approved episodes: 16 of its 17 imported videos have source.embeddable=false (Stanford has disabled embedding for that course's uploads), so none of them can ever be scheduled without bypassing YouTube's own restrictions -- left here, dormant, exactly like Science & Engineering's own unused-but-referenced series, in case Stanford re-enables embedding later.
